---
title: "embedpdf names with a percent sign"
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
resources:
  - "files/100%.pdf"
---

Both embeds show `files/100%.pdf`, a copy of `sample.pdf` whose file name
holds a `%`. This page is built with `embed-resources: true`, so each PDF is
inside the page. The first embed gives the path as `files/100%25.pdf`, and
the second gives it with a bare `%`. The viewer names the embeds
"PDF: 100%.pdf (1 of 2)" and "PDF: 100%.pdf (2 of 2)" for screen readers. The
checks in `tests/` read those names.
